disclaimer.all_information_provided_on: All information provided on the KrishiAI platform, including but not limited to crop predictions, disease diagnoses, mandi prices, government schemes eligibility, and weather advisories, is for informational and educational purposes only.
disclaimer.the_content_is_provided: The content is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. We make no representations or warranties of any kind, express or implied, as to the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of the AI suggestions generated by the system.
disclaimer.our_crop_disease_ai: Our Crop Disease AI processes user-submitted photos to recognize patterns representing leaf damage, insect feeding, or mold.
disclaimer.machine_learning_models_can: Machine learning models can experience false positives or fail to detect rare disease variants.
disclaimer.recommended_pesticides_insecticides_fung: Recommended pesticides, insecticides, fungicides, or organic treatments represent suggestions and must be cross-verified with manufacturers' chemical labels.
disclaimer.we_are_not_responsible: We are not responsible for any crop failure, soil degradation, or physical/financial harm resulting from incorrect chemical application ratios or model error.
disclaimer.weather_data_is_compiled: Weather data is compiled from third-party meteorological providers. We cannot be held liable for sudden shifts in temperature, unpredicted rainfall, or hail storms that affect your crops.
disclaimer.market_prices_are_updated: Market prices are updated dynamically based on APMC market dashboards. Due to network latency, geographical differences, and loading variables:
disclaimer.the_prices_displayed_might: The prices displayed might lag behind local physical mandi rates.
disclaimer.set_target_notifications_are: Set target notifications are alerts to assist you and are not guaranteed to fire instantly.

disclaimer.krishiai_offers_an_interactive: KrishiAI offers an interactive eligibility tool for central schemes such as PM-Kisan, PMFBY, and KCC.

cookie_policy.cookies_are_small_text: Cookies are small text files placed on your computer or mobile device by websites that you visit. They are widely used to make websites work more efficiently, improve your navigation experience, and provide information to the website owners.
cookie_policy.we_use_both_first: We use both first-party and third-party cookies on our platform to support different operational functions. The cookies we utilize fall under the following categories:
cookie_policy.these_cookies_are_critical: These cookies are critical to authorize user sessions and keep you logged into your account. Without these cookies, features like Khet Diary logs or custom profile tracking cannot be provided.
cookie_policy.these_cookies_allow_us: These cookies allow us to remember decisions you make, such as your selected translation language (krishiai_lang). This prevents you from having to select your language script on every page refresh.
cookie_policy.we_run_telemetry_scripts: We run telemetry scripts (e.g. Vercel Analytics) that deploy anonymous cookie structures. These monitor site loading latency, page visits, and click rates to help us optimize backend server response times.
cookie_policy.third_party_vendors_including: Third-party vendors, including Google AdSense, use cookies to serve advertisements based on your prior visits to KrishiAI or other web portals.
cookie_policy.you_have_the_right: You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject cookies. You can modify your browser settings to clear existing cookies or block new cookies altogether.
cookie_policy.to_opt_out_of: To opt out of Google's personalized advertising cookies, navigate to Google's Ads Settings.
cookie_policy.for_any_further_questions: For any further questions regarding our cookie disclosures, please send us a mail at founders@krishiaiindia.com.

landing_dashboard.input_your_n_p: Input your N-P-K chemical levels, pH balance, organic carbon content, and land coordinates. KrishiAI crosses these with climate projections to output optimal crop choices.
landing_dashboard.identify_plant_sicknesses_immediately: Identify plant sicknesses immediately. Upload leaf photos of potato, tomato, cotton, or wheat. Our model processes details to recognize pathogen spots and outline a targeted cure.

landing_dashboard.integrates_weather_api_feeds: Integrates weather API feeds directly with crop stages to alert you when severe wind, high heat, or sudden rain threatens pesticide cycles or harvesting timelines.
landing_dashboard.do_not_apply_liquid: Do not apply liquid urea fertilizers or run irrigation channels within the next 24 hours. Storm water runoff will wash nutrients away and cause soil stagnation.

landing_faq.krishiai_is_an_ai: KrishiAI is an AI-powered smart agriculture platform designed to help Indian farmers make data-driven decisions. The platform gathers location, soil metrics, and crop images to provide forecasts, predictions, market rates, and disease diagnoses.
landing_faq.how_does_the_crop: How does the Crop Disease Detector work?
landing_faq.you_simply_take_a: You simply take a photo of the infected crop leaf and upload it to the platform. Our machine learning classification models analyze the visual features to diagnose the specific disease and recommend remedies within 2 seconds.
landing_faq.yes_krishiai_is_currently: Yes! KrishiAI is currently in its early access beta phase and is completely free for all farmers, agriculturalists, and partners.
landing_faq.does_krishiai_support_local: Does KrishiAI support local Indian languages?
landing_faq.absolutely_krishiai_features_full: Absolutely. KrishiAI features full voice query support and interfaces in Hindi, Kannada, and English. You can speak directly to the AI Assistant by clicking the microphone button.
landing_faq.how_accurate_are_the: How accurate are the crop recommendations?
landing_faq.our_soil_health_ai: Our Soil Health AI model outputs crop choices with a verified 95% accuracy score by crossing your inputted NPK levels, soil pH, and organic carbon (OC) with historical crop yields and weather histories.
landing_faq.can_i_monitor_live: Can I monitor live market mandi prices?
landing_faq.yes_the_mandi_pricing: Yes. The Mandi Pricing engine tracks live APMC market quotes across India daily. You can search for your specific crop and set target price alerts to notify you when prices cross thresholds.
landing_faq.how_does_krishiai_help: How does KrishiAI help with government schemes?
landing_faq.by_inputting_details_like: By inputting details like your land size and age, our Schemes tool scans active central schemes (like PM-Kisan, PMFBY, and KCC) to find programs you qualify for, providing direct links to apply.
landing_faq.what_is_the_khet: What is the Khet Diary feature?
landing_faq.khet_diary_is_a: Khet Diary is a digital farm logbook. It allows you to log daily farm activities, record expenses, document weather conditions, and upload crop images to track progress over cycles.
landing_faq.what_is_the_smart: What is the Smart Hub hardware showcase?
landing_faq.it_demonstrates_integrations_with: It demonstrates integrations with physical IoT hardware blocks (soil moisture sensors, automatic water valves, and NPK readers). This allows smart monitoring and automated irrigation control directly from the dashboard.
landing_faq.how_do_i_get: How do I get started with KrishiAI?
landing_faq.you_can_get_started: You can get started immediately by clicking the 'Get Started' or 'Launch KrishiAI' buttons. Create a free account or use the guest mode to access all tools immediately.
